LanguageData.CC_Story3_Searched: {PAWN} has searched everywhere in the marked area that can be reached from here.
LanguageData.CC_Story3_Dream_Told: {GOD} showed me a place {WAY} of the colony and asked for a {KIND} to be built there.
LanguageData.CC_Story3_Dream_ToldAgain: {GOD} came to me in a dream again and asked for an offering at the new {KIND}.
LanguageData.CC_Story3_Dream_Believes: {GOD} asked me in my dreams for a {KIND} and an offering, and we gave both.
LanguageData.CC_Story3_Dream_Nothing: Nothing has been built yet for {GOD} at the marked place, {WAY} of the colony.
LanguageData.CC_Story3_Dream_Standing: The {PLACE} stands at the marked place. Someone of the colony will go and give it to {GOD}.
LanguageData.CC_Story3_Dream_Watch: Watch kept at the {KIND} tonight: {HOURS} of {NEED} hours.
LanguageData.CC_Story3_Dream_Offering: The dream asked for {WHAT} at the {KIND}.
LanguageData.CC_Story3_Dream_Sign: {PAWN} was keeping the watch at the new {KIND} in the night when a light came over it for a short while.
LanguageData.CC_Story3_Raiders_Defences: Traps or turrets built: {GUARDS} of {TRAPS}. Lengths of wall, fence or barricade built: {BUILT} of {WALLS}.
LanguageData.CC_Story3_Raiders_Coming: The raiders of {OTHERPEOPLE} are coming within a few days.
LanguageData.CC_Story3_Raiders_Fight: The raiders are on the colony's land.
LanguageData.CC_Story3_Raiders_RaidText: Raiders from the {KIND} of {OTHERPEOPLE} have come to test the colony, as {FACTION} warned they would.
LanguageData.CC_Story3_Raiders_RefusedText: The colony refused to pay {OTHERPEOPLE} this season, and raiders from their {KIND} have come for it.
LanguageData.CC_Story3_Raiders_RefusedQuiet: {OTHERPEOPLE} did not come for the price the colony refused them this season.
LanguageData.CC_Story3_Raiders_StrikeNear: The {KIND} is marked on the world map. {COUNT} fighters of the colony's neighbours will join the colony's people there.
LanguageData.CC_Story3_Raiders_StrikeFar: The fighters of {FACTION} have set out for the camp.
LanguageData.CC_Story3_Well_Leaving: {PAWN} is going out to {RIVAL} at the gate. They will set out for the town together.
LanguageData.CC_Story3_Well_Left: {PAWN} has set out for {PLACE} to help dig a new well, and will be back in about {DAYS}.
LanguageData.CC_Story3_Well_Away: {PAWN} is at {PLACE}, digging. Back in about {DAYS}.
LanguageData.CC_Story3_Well_Refugees: {COUNT} people of the town arrive within {DAYS}.
LanguageData.CC_Story3_Vault_Working: Days of work at the {BENCH}: {WORKED}. Days lost for want of a component: {SHORT}.
LanguageData.CC_Story3_Vault_CaseAsking: The colony is deciding whether to open the case.
LanguageData.CC_Story3_Vault_CaseKept: The sealed case is in the colony's care. Their runner comes back for it in about {DAYS}.
LanguageData.CC_Story3_Vault_ImpactKeep: The case stays sealed, and the runner of {FACTION} takes it back in a few days.
LanguageData.CC_Story3_Vault_ImpactOpen: The case is opened by the stores. It may hold someone asleep, a machine that attacks, or old goods.
LanguageData.CC_Story3_Grave_Searching: Right-click inside the marked area with a colonist to search for {NAME}'s grave.
LanguageData.CC_Story3_Grave_TheirSearch: One of {FACTION} is searching for the grave.
LanguageData.CC_Story3_Grave_Year: Mourners of {FACTION} have come to spend a few hours at the grave of {NAME}, as they do each year.
LanguageData.CC_Story3_Grave_YearLost: Mourners of {FACTION} came to the grave of {NAME} and found it gone or built over. They hold it against the colony, and will not come again.
